about_the_game:
The Warhammer Skulls event is back with more opportunities for you to experience the fascinating science fantasy universe of Warhammer 40,000.

And what better way to get familiar with World of Warships’ Warhammer 40,000 content than a free test drive of two mighty space battleships?

This package includes:

  • Ship rental*: Tier VIII battleship Ignis Purgatio**

  • Ship rental*: Tier VIII battleship Ragnarok**

  • 3x Protector of the Faith expendable camouflages

  • 3x Primordial Annihilator expendable camouflages


*Each individual ship will be removed from your account either after playing 10 battles with it, or after 30 days have passed since unlocking this DLC.

** Both ships fall under the Japanese in-game nation and can be crewed by Japanese Commanders.

This time-limited exclusive DLC is only available between 21 May and 4 June, 2025.
